answer: Because the prism count is verified against the sonnet text itself, the tide audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 98 aliases thus means producing 98 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 6 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
